images.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create EXACTLY ONE portrait image, same canvas aspect and full-body standing height/framing as Image 1. Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER, direction S; preserve this exact young woman's identity, hair mass, skin, costume, proportions, equipment and standing rest pose while rotating the CHARACTER to NE. NE means facing viewer's UPPER-RIGHT, turned 135 degrees from the front-facing master: back and anatomical LEFT side visible, face turned completely away and NEVER visible. Olive satchel on anatomical LEFT hip is SCREEN-LEFT, nearer camera. Plain upright walnut staff in anatomical RIGHT hand is SCREEN-RIGHT, farther/behind. Single chestnut harness strap passes over anatomical RIGHT shoulder diagonally to LEFT hip, visible appropriately across back. This is a true rotation, NEVER a mirrored image. Fixed elevated three-quarter pinhole camera approximately 53 degrees above ground plane, projection C; camera does not rotate. Full body centered, feet entirely visible, even weight, same relaxed rest pose with right hand holding staff upright. Preserve dark curly hair tied back, sun-browned skin, ivory linen shirt, navy sleeveless long tabard with plain surfaces, ONE diagonal chestnut satchel strap, ONE waist belt, chestnut laced bracers, navy trousers and chestnut buckled boots. Staff is PLAIN dark walnut with small brass ferrules at foot and tip; no ring, no headpiece. No extra objects, no insignia or emblem anywhere. Painted 2D illustration, high resolution, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, readable silhouette, no conspicuous brush grain. Blue/ivory/brass palette and chestnut leather as master. Single key light from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT fixed in screen space; screen-left silhouette slightly rim-lit, deep cool low-value ambient and readable shadows never pure black. No spell glow. NO floor shadow. Whole background is perfectly flat uniform pure #00ff00, opaque green from edge to edge; no gradients, checkerboard, environment or floor. Do not matte. Deliver the single portrait turnaround requested for this burst, no sheet, labels, or text.
